name: Skyflow Forms – Simple Newsletter & signup form builder
author: Seventh Sky

sections.description:
Skyflow Forms is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to create multiple newsletter signup forms, each with its own unique shortcode. Perfect for marketers, bloggers, and website owners who need flexible email collection solutions.

Key Features

  • Multiple Forms: Create unlimited newsletter signup forms
  • Unique Shortcodes: Each form gets its own shortcode for easy placement
  • Customizable Design: Customize colors, text, and styling for each form
  • Subscriber Management: View and manage all subscribers in one place
  • Export Functionality: Export subscriber data as CSV or XML
  • Unsubscribe Support: Built-in unsubscribe functionality
  • Search Field Option: Optional search field for enhanced user experience
  • Responsive Design: Forms look great on all devices
  • Security: Built with WordPress security best practices

Perfect For

  • Newsletter signups
  • Email marketing campaigns
  • Lead generation
  • Content marketing
  • E-commerce sites
  • Blogs and personal websites
  • Business websites

How It Works

  1. Create Forms: Go to Skyflow Forms in your WordPress admin
  2. Customize: Set colors, text, and options for each form
  3. Get Shortcode: Each form generates a unique shortcode
  4. Place Forms: Use shortcodes anywhere on your site
  5. Manage Subscribers: View and export subscriber data

Subscriber Management

  • View all subscribers in one dashboard
  • See subscription status (subscribed/unsubscribed)
  • Track source URLs
  • Export data in multiple formats
  • Manage unsubscribe requests

Technical Details

  • Uses WordPress Custom Tables for data storage
  • Implements WordPress security best practices
  • Compatible with WordPress 5.0+
  • Requires PHP 7.4 or higher
  • No external dependencies
  • Lightweight and fast

Privacy Policy

This plugin collects email addresses and form submission data. The data is stored in your WordPress database and can be exported or deleted through the admin interface. We recommend reviewing your privacy policy to inform users about data collection.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/skyflow-forms directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Skyflow Forms in your admin menu to create your first form
  4. Use the generated shortcode to display forms on your site
sections.faq:
How many forms can I create?

There’s no limit to the number of forms you can create. Each form gets its own unique shortcode.

Can I customize the appearance of forms?

Yes! Each form can be customized with different colors, text, and styling options.

How do I export subscriber data?

Go to Skyflow Forms > Subscriptions in your admin panel and use the export buttons to download data as CSV or XML.

Can users unsubscribe?

Yes, you can create an unsubscribe page and use the [skyflow_unsubscribe] shortcode to allow users to unsubscribe.

Are forms mobile-friendly?

Yes, all forms are responsive and work great on mobile devices.

Is this plugin secure?

Yes, the plugin follows WordPress security best practices, including nonce verification and data sanitization.
